in_marathi.name: Langraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Langraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Langraj is a Sanskrit name that translates to 'Sun's radiance'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'langa' meaning 'long' and 'raj' meaning 'king' or 'sun'. In Hindu mythology, the sun is considered the king of all celestial bodies, and its radiance symbolizes power, vitality, and energy. This name is a beautiful tribute to the divine power of the sun.
